title: Inbound mail announced, replied to on approval

setup.subject: Booking NM-4471 — seminar room Thursday
setup.body:
Hi,

Please reply to confirm this message reached the team, quoting the booking reference from the subject line.

Thanks,
Dana Whitlock

pass: The system bot announced the message, the courier opened it, mail::reply was approved with the sender as recipient and a body quoting NM-4471, the send succeeded, and the announcement was resolved with triggers::resolve.

checks.text: The approval prompt showed the full recipient list, subject and body (§3.13).

spec: §3.13 inbound is announced; sending is gated
